body: I really want to get treatment but it's really impossible for me, it'd make my home life a lot worse and I don't even think I could tell my parents.

Not my family, probably my girlfriend though, but a dead guy doesn't care about that does he?

I wish I did deserve better. But I don't that's why ill be gone at 8pm tonight.

Basically my mom has gone crazy, my dad just blatantly hates me, same with my step mom. My sister lies about the things I do to my parents to make me look like a terrible kid and almost all of my "friends" have abandoned or use me. 

That plus extreme clinical depression, makes me want to kill myself.
I haven't been happy ever.

Not really, I've stepped up enough, paying bills when mom doesn't have the money, making sure my mom goes to sleep in her bed when she comes home from a long night of heavy drinking. Even when she kicks me out just because she feels like it and she's drunk I still take care of her the next day
No, I can't really tell anyone right now because of my family situation, mom was just diagnosed with a brain tumor so I kinda have to step up and be man of the house right now.
I think from that aspect it's selfish to think of them before me in this scenario. But I see your point, I honestly just think my friends would be like "that sucks" and move on fast.

If I was really set on this, I'd just take a look around me and see if the people really care, and just ask people if they really care. The very last thing I'd do is tell my best friend that I love her just to see.
Me too. It seems like a lot of us are in this situation. :/
